body: The second key was a small, unassuming square, but it carried a different weight. I noticed it was a key to an old piano, the same one I had used for my latest album. I felt a surge of unease, realizing the key could be used to play the song I had been working on for months. It was almost as if someone was trying to sabotage my work.
